name: Back to Basics 3
source: written 28 Aug 2026. Level 3 of three. The same six shapes at their real version, and the level where the clock and the failure point become part of the prescription.
entryIf: You can hold a 3-1-1 tempo squat for 4 × 8, do 10 push-ups from the floor, and hang for 45 seconds. Level 3 asks what you have; it does not teach you what to do.

methods.name: EMOM
methods.what: One set on the top of every minute. The rest is whatever is left of that minute.
methods.why: The clock sets the rest, not how you feel. It makes pacing a skill instead of a mood.

methods.name: AMRAP
methods.what: As many rounds as possible inside a time cap.
methods.why: Density you can compare week to week. The number IS the progress.

methods.name: Max set
methods.what: One set to honest failure, recorded.
methods.why: Four weeks of work needs a number at the end of it, or nothing was measured.

methods.name: Rest-pause
methods.what: One load, short breaks, keep going to a rep target.
methods.why: More hard reps than straight sets allow, without adding a set.

methods.name: Circuit
methods.what: Straight through every movement, then rest, then again.
methods.why: The conditioning cost of strength work, kept in one block so the rest of the session stays clean.

methods.name: Complex
methods.what: Several movements with the same implement, no putting it down.
methods.why: Grip, breathing and technique under fatigue, all at once.

constraints.time: 40 minutes, three days. Week 4 is a test week and it is shorter, not longer.

goals: Put a number on all six shapes
Hold a pace set by a clock rather than by feel
Finish a hard set without the shape falling apart
Know which of the six is your weakest, with evidence

d1.name: Squat & Push
d1.why: A heavy squat opens it while you are fresh, then the pushing goes on the clock. The EMOM is the point of the day — the same eight reps get harder every minute without the weight changing.

blocks.name: A · Goblet Squat
blocks.note: 5 × 5, rest 120s. Heavy for five. Week 4 this becomes one max set.

items.note: 120s rest · TEST in week 4 · stop one rep before the shape goes

blocks.name: B · Push-Up EMOM
blocks.note: 8 reps on the top of every minute for 10 minutes. If you cannot finish a minute, stop the block and write down which minute it was.

items.note: the rest is whatever is left of the minute

blocks.name: Hollow
blocks.note: Rest-pause. One long hold, break when you must, back on until the clock says 90 seconds of work.

items.note: 20s rest · lower back stays on the floor or the set is over

d2.name: Hinge & Pull
d2.why: The heaviest day. The deadlift pattern gets real load and the longest rest in the program, then the pulling is tested with a max set — because a pull-up number is the one people actually remember.

blocks.name: Hips and shoulders
blocks.note: Two rounds, unhurried. Longer than the others on purpose.

blocks.name: A · Romanian Deadlift
blocks.note: 4 × 6, rest 150s. The strictest stop rule in the program: the set ends the rep the back changes shape, not the rep after.

items.note: 150s rest · TEST in week 4 · hips back, flat back, slow down

blocks.name: B · Pull-Up, max set
blocks.note: One warm-up set of half your best, then ONE set to honest failure. Write the number down.

items.note: 180s rest · the second set is the test — go to failure and record it

blocks.name: C · Kettlebell Swing
blocks.note: 6 × 12, rest 45s. Fast, and the short rest is the work.

d3.name: Full Body
d3.why: The engine day. An AMRAP covering all six shapes, then a carry complex to finish — the number of rounds is the thing you compare in four weeks, not how it felt.

blocks.name: A · Dip + Ring Row
blocks.note: A1 into A2, no rest, then 90s. The two shapes level 1 could not touch.

items.note: superset A1 · bench dip is the honest regression, not a failure
superset A2 · feet forward to make it harder

blocks.name: B · Six Shapes AMRAP
blocks.note: 15 minutes. As many rounds as possible. Write the number down — that number is the whole point of this block.

blocks.name: Carry complex
blocks.note: Three rounds. Farmer's carry 30 seconds straight into a suitcase carry 20 seconds each side, without putting the weight down.

items.note: do not put it down between the two
